title: Understanding the Model
text: The model for the observation is given by \( \hat{y}_i=f_{\theta_1}(x_i)=\theta_{1}\log(x_i) \). This means that each predicted value \( \hat{y}_i \) is a function of \( $$x_i$$ \) and the parameter \( $$\theta_1$$ \).

title: Mean Squared Error (MSE)
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) is defined as \( \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**n(y_i-f_{\theta_1}(x_i))**2 \). This is the quantity we want to minimize with respect to \( $$\theta_1$$ \).

title: Setting Up the Derivative
text: To find the minimizer \( \hat{\theta}_1 \), take the derivative of the MSE with respect to \( $$\theta_1$$ \) and set it to zero. This will give you the condition for the minimum.
